# Postman Evidence Checklist

Student: Dawn Andrei C. Pamesa  Section: TS31

Submit screenshots or exported responses only after redacting credential values.

**The evidence in `evidence/` is simulated**, generated by Claude Code against a stand-in server
that implements the documented API contract, with URLs shown as the local simulator's. Every file and
image is labelled as simulated. It was produced with `capture_evidence.py`, which sends each request and
saves method, URL, status and a response summary per request in `evidence/`, with the password and
token replaced by `<redacted>` before anything is written. `evidence/evidence_summary.md` tabulates
expected against actual status for every step. Running the same script inside the DEVASC VM
replaces the simulated files with real captures.

- [x] R1: GET all books, with URL and 200 status visible (`evidence/R1_list_books.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R2: GET books using `includeISBN=true` and `sortBy=author` (`evidence/R2_isbn_sorted.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R3: Basic Auth request and 200 status; token value fully hidden (`evidence/R3_login_basic.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R4: POST a fictional book, with JSON body and 200 status visible (`evidence/R4_add_book.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R5: GET the newly added book by ID (`evidence/R5_get_book_by_id.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R6: DELETE the newly added book by ID (`evidence/R6_delete_book.json` and `.png`)
- [x] R7: Intentional local failure showing 401 with key values hidden (`evidence/R7_401_missing_key.json` and `.png`)
- [x] Final successful verification after correcting R7 (`evidence/R7_fixed_200.json` and `.png`)
- [x] Offline validator output showing all checks passed (`validator_output.txt`)

The requests were built as the Postman collection `CS0016_M4_Library_API.postman_collection.json`,
which carries a status-code test for every step, so each screenshot also shows the test result.
The collection's credential and token variables are blank in the submitted copy.

Never export or submit a live Postman environment containing secrets.
